title: Claude Code plugin manifest (local compatibility schema)
$comment: LOCAL COMPATIBILITY SCHEMA -- NOT AN OFFICIAL HOST SCHEMA. Host behaviour remains authoritative; this schema encodes only the subset of fields agent-harness relies on at M1, so it can catch our own mistakes early. A file passing this schema is not thereby guaranteed to be accepted by the host. Official documentation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins

name.description: kebab-case; also the Skill namespace prefix
name.$comment: Official-Documented: the plugin name is the unique identifier and Skill namespace, and the host validator rejects uppercase, spaces and special characters as a kebab-case error. Canonical kebab-case. The vendor states 'kebab-case, no spaces' and its validator rejects uppercase, spaces and special characters; rejection of leading, trailing and repeated hyphens is a Local-M1-Policy refinement of that term, not a separately published rule.
